environment.description: AWS Lambda behind Application Load Balancer with HTTPS:443 listener configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) passthrough mode. The ALB trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/ts-prod-upload/abc123) references a private CA bundle (internal-corp-ca-2024.pem) containing only the organization's intermediate CA. The listener default action has type 'fixed-response' returning 403; a forward rule with condition 'header: X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Serial-Number exists' routes to the Lambda target group. Connection-level TLS negotiation rejects clients without a valid certificate chain rooted in the trust store CA before HTTP processing begins. The ALB access logs show the mutual_authentication_result field must equal 'success' for any forwarded request. Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway attached to the Lambda's subnet — all S3 access is via VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) with a restrictive endpoint policy scoping PutObject to the specific bucket.

config.vpc_endpoint_policy: allow s3:PutObject on upload bucket only
